senses.gloss: pr. n. pl. (Σωγάνη, Jos. Vita 51) Sikhnin (Sukhnin), north of Jotapata in Galilee, seat of R. Ḥănania b. T’radyon, and home of R. Joshua.
units: <cite ref="Sanhedrin 32b">Snh. 32ᵇ</cite> <he>לס׳</he> (v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 30).—
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 4:1:22">Y. Ber. IV, 7ᵇ</cite> bot., a. fr. <he>ר׳ יהושע דס׳</he>.
<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 5:5">Lev. R. s. 5</cite> (ref. to <he>הסכן</he>, <cite ref="Isaiah 22:15">Is. XXII, 15</cite>) <he>מן הדא ס׳ הוה</he> he came from Sikhnin.—
<cite ref="Tosefta Niddah 3:11">Tosef. Nidd. III, 11</cite> <he>בקעת סכני</he> the Valley of S.—Cmp. <cite ref="O00563"><he>סִיגְנָא</he> II</cite>.
